description:
You are working as a drafter preparing manufacturing documentation for a T8 lead screw housing bracket. The 3D model is already loaded in FreeCAD.

Your task:
1. Switch to the TechDraw workbench.
2. Create a new TechDraw drawing page using any available A4 Landscape template.
3. Select the 3D part/shape from the model tree.
4. Insert a front projection view of the bracket onto the drawing page.
5. Also add top and right-side projection views (you may use 'Insert Projection Group' for all three, or insert them individually).
6. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_bracket_drawing.FCStd'.
7. Export the TechDraw page to PDF at '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_bracket_drawing.pdf'.

The final FCStd file must contain a TechDraw Page with at least one (ideally three) orthographic projection views. The PDF must contain the exported drawing.
